breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification combines both conflicting methods into the ambiguous phrase 'semi-implicit time integration with explicit forward Euler' instead of cleanly removing the explicit forward Euler instruction as the ground truth does. The ground truth specifies only the semi-implicit method with its formula and the requirement to solve a sparse linear system each step. The generated text retains 'explicit forward Euler' language and omits the semi-implicit formula and sparse linear system requirement.
